name: recovered_mbqa_reconstruction_v0
notes: Thresholds are reconstructed from first-party source and have not been validated against the conference inclusion decisions.
The 1000 Hz sampling rate corrects the recovered flatline call that used 100 Hz.
The minimum-variance threshold remains unset because the recovered value was derived at import time from private calibration files.
The configuration must not exclude recordings or authorize training until an authoritative adjudication validates it.
